newsitem.title: USA: UIH says Australian unit gets US$155 mln bank financing.
newsitem.headline: UIH says Australian unit gets US$155 mln bank financing.

text.p: UIH Asia/Pacific Communications Inc, a unit of United International Holdings Inc said Monday its Australian multichannel television firm AUSTAR has received an underwritten commitment from Chase Manhattan Bank for a senior syndicated term debt facility of $155 million.
The company said the proceeds will be used to fund the balance of AUSTAR's subscriber acquisition, and for working capital needs in its 1.5 million home franchise area.
Cash advance and term loan portions of the transaction will be fully repayable pursuant to an amortization schedule beginning December 31, 2001 and ending June 30, 2004, said UIH.
The company said that Chase has also provided AUSTAR with an interim financing facility of which will be refinanced from the proceeds of the $155 million bank facility.
UIH said that proceeds from this financing, together with an additional $18 million of equity, will fully fund AUSTAR's long-term business plan.
AUSTAR is the largest provider of multichannel television services in regional Australia.
